2607.01964.title: Beyond Supervised Clarification: Input Rewriting with LLMs for Dialogue Discourse Parsing
2607.01964.paper_summary: Rewriting inputs to improve frozen downstream models has become a common strategy in modern NLP pipelines. Prior work on incremental dialogue discourse parsing (DDP) shows that supervised clarification models can rewrite fragmentary or underspecified utterances, such as resolving ellipsis or references, to improve parsing accuracy. In this work, we revisit this idea under realistic deployment conditions, where no clarification supervision is available and the clarifier must rely on zero-shot prompting or feedback from a frozen parser. Across three Segmented Discourse Representation Theory (SDRT) datasets and multiple parsers, we find that last-utterance clarification is far less reliable than suggested by supervised settings. Parser-agnostic rewriting often introduces more regressions than repairs, as edits that enable fixes also disrupt discourse cues relied upon by the parser. A best-of-8 rewriting analysis further reveals a practical ceiling: a large fraction of errors are not repairable through input rewriting alone. A parser-aware clarifier trained with GRPO reduces regressions by up to 37% by learning conservative abstention, yet still fails to produce selectivity-aware clarifications that consistently improve parsing. Together, these findings recast clarification as a selective intervention problem. We identify rewritability prediction, deciding whether an utterance is repairable before intervention, as the key missing capability for input-side optimization of frozen discourse parsers, and a critical direction for improving agentic pipelines more broadly.
2607.01964.paper_summary_zh: 重寫輸入以改善凍結的下游模型已成為現代自然語言處理管道中的一種常見策略。先前在增量對話話語解析（DDP）方面的研究顯示，監督式澄清模型可以重寫片段或未明確的話語，例如解決省略或參考，以提高解析準確性。在這項工作中，我們在現實部署條件下重新檢視這一想法，這裡沒有澄清監督可用，澄清者必須依賴零樣本提示或來自凍結解析器的反饋。在三個分段話語表示理論（SDRT）數據集和多個解析器中，我們發現最後一句話的澄清遠不如監督設置所建議的那樣可靠。解析器無關的重寫通常引入的回歸比修復更多，因為使修復成為可能的編輯也會干擾解析器所依賴的話語線索。最佳的8次重寫分析進一步揭示了一個實際的上限：大量錯誤無法僅通過輸入重寫來修復。使用GRPO訓練的解析器感知澄清者通過學習保守的放棄將回歸減少了多達37％，但仍然無法產生始終提高解析的選擇性意識澄清。總體而言，這些發現將澄清重新定義為一個選擇性干預問題。我們確定重寫可預測性，即在干預之前決定一個話語是否可修復，作為凍結話語解析器輸入側優化的關鍵缺失能力，以及更廣泛改善代理管道的關鍵方向。
